_: What a migration file leaves behind when its statements do not say it (scripts/lib/migration-probes.mjs): the database of a file without \c, and extra probes (SQL expressions that are true when the effect is there). Read only.

infra/migrations/2026-09-04-capability-u.label: uri_path is nullable, or the column is gone (the capability table dropped the HTTP endpoint)
infra/migrations/2026-09-04-capability-u.sql: NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'orazaka_capabilities' AND column_name = 'uri_path') OR (SELECT is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'orazaka_capabilities' AND column_name = 'uri_path') = 'YES'

infra/migrations/2026-09-16-media-billab.label: audio, speech, vision and video analysis carry their media billable unit
infra/migrations/2026-09-16-media-billab.sql: (SELECT count(*) FROM orazaka_capabilities WHERE (feature_key, billable_unit) IN (('orazaka.core.media.audio','AUDIO_MINUTE'),('orazaka.core.chat.speech','KILOCHAR'),('orazaka.core.media.vision','KILOTOKEN'),('orazaka.core.media.video.analysis','AUDIO_MINUTE'))) = (SELECT count(*) FROM orazaka_capabilities WHERE feature_key IN ('orazaka.core.media.audio','orazaka.core.chat.speech','orazaka.core.media.vision','orazaka.core.media.video.analysis'))
